theorem lg_target {α β : Type u} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f <*> s).Finite := by
  let f_set := f
  let s_set := s
  have h_finite_f : f.Finite := hf
  have h_finite_s : s.Finite := hs
  have h_finite_product : (f × s).Finite := by
    apply prod.finite_set_of_finite_sets h_finite_f h_finite_s
  have h_finite_images : ∀ g ∈ f, (g ∘ s).Finite := by
    intro g hg
    have : (g ∘ s).Finite := by
      apply image_finite
      exact h_finite_s
    exact this
  have h_finite_union : (⋃ g ∈ f, (g ∘ s)).Finite := by
    apply finite_bigunion
    exact h_finite_product
    exact h_finite_images
  exact h_finite_union
